description: This file implements the TransactionQueue class for managing distributed transaction states in Orleans. It handles transaction enqueuing, commit, abort, notification, recovery, and storage interactions, encapsulating the logic for a transactional state queue within Orleans transactions.

classes.name: TransactionQueue<TState>
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and state of distributed transactions, including queuing, commit/abort operations, recovery from storage, and communication with transaction participants within Orleans.

classes.name: PreparedMessages
classes.description: A helper class for tracking the number and status of prepared messages associated with specific transaction timestamps.

methods.name: EnqueueCommit
methods.description: Enqueues a transaction commit record and processes it based on its role (read-only, local, remote), including persisting preparations and handling prepared messages.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepared
methods.description: Handles notification that a transaction has been prepared with a specific status, updating local commit queue or storing ahead-of-time notifications.

methods.name: NotifyOfPrepare
methods.description: Notifies the queue of a prepare message from a participant, validating lock and updating transaction record accordingly.

methods.name: NotifyOfAbort
methods.description: Handles abort notification for a transaction, notifying participants and completing related task completion sources.

methods.name: NotifyOfPing
methods.description: Processes ping messages from transaction managers to detect crashes or delays, possibly triggering cancellation.

methods.name: NotifyOfConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation notifications for committed transactions, updating the state and awaiting batch processing.

methods.name: NotifyOfCancel
methods.description: Processes cancellation of transactions, performing abort logic and removing from queues.

methods.name: NotifyOfRestore
methods.description: Performs recovery after activation or failure, loading state from storage and resuming operations.

methods.name: Ready
methods.description: Ensures the transaction queue is prepared and ready for processing, including recovery if needed.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Loads previous transaction and commit state from storage during recovery.

methods.name: GetMostRecentState
methods.description: Retrieves the latest stable state and sequence number for the transaction queue.

methods.name: BatchableOperationsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of batchable operations at the end of the commit queue.

methods.name: StorageWork
methods.description: Performs storage-related work in the background, including storing committed state, detecting conflicts, and managing state transitions.

methods.name: AbortAndRestore
methods.description: Sets the queue into an abort and restore process when errors occur.

methods.name: Bail
methods.description: Performs cleanup after errors, aborting transactions, and deactivating the grain if necessary.

methods.name: CheckProgressOfCommitQueue
methods.description: Monitors the progress of the commit queue, sending pings or aborting timed-out transactions.

methods.name: CollectEventsForBatch
methods.description: Prepares storage batch data based on current commit queue elements for persistence.

methods.name: OnLocalCommit
methods.description: Handles local commit actions, including preparing storage batch entries and notifying the transaction agent.

methods.name: AbortCommits
methods.description: Aborts a range of commit queue entries starting from a specified index.
